_about: Pictures for the site page 'Discovering the work' (finds.html), one under each find. Site only, not in the book. Every one is public domain on Wikimedia Commons; ktfindpics.py fetches them into work/rohonc/finds/, ktsite.py places them after the paragraph that opens with `after`.

pictures.commons: File:Frères Limbourg - Très Riches Heures du duc de Berry - chute des anges rebelles - Google Art Project.jpg
pictures.caption: The fall of the rebel angels, from the Très Riches Heures of the Duke of Berry, painted by the Limbourg brothers, 1411–1416. Musée Condé, Chantilly.

pictures.commons: File:Piero della Francesca - 1. Death of Adam - WGA17474.jpg
pictures.after: Adam healed by the branch has a Hungarian relative.
pictures.caption: The death of Adam as the Golden Legend tells it: Adam dies, Seth goes to the angel at the gate of paradise, and the branch is planted on Adam's grave. Piero della Francesca, 1452–1466. San Francesco, Arezzo.

pictures.after: Elijah at the fall of the angels.
pictures.caption: Enoch and Elijah preach against the Antichrist and are put to death by him, as at 133v. A drawing from a French Apocalypse manuscript, as reproduced in L'Apocalypse en français.

pictures.commons: File:Botticelli, pala di san barnaba, predella 02.jpg
pictures.after: The author cites what he was taught.
pictures.caption: Augustine on the shore and the child emptying the sea into a hole, the story told on 084r. Sandro Botticelli, a panel under the San Barnaba altarpiece, about 1488. Uffizi, Florence.
The title page of Carion's Chronicle, first German edition, 1532, the book at whose head Melanchthon set the six thousand years.
